Messages.Author: Henrik Isaksson
Messages.Body:
Derange card text: (d) Put this card on a younger vampire. The vampire with
this card is considered to be the same clan as the acting vampire. (...)

What happens if a Malk plays derange on another vampire, and then clan
impersonated into another clan? Is the vampire with derange considered to be
the new clan or still malkavian? The card text seem to imply that the clan
of the acting vampire is checked continously, but I don't think that's the
intent of the carddesign...

/Henrik Isaksson
